name: ライブ記事のタイトルと分類
prompt:
Create a single landscape news headline panel, following the supplied Guardian source crop for the composition and the localized native preview for Lighthouse styling and Japanese copy. Use a solid deep green background exactly like the preview (#047857), with high-contrast white type. Place a small white circular live-status dot and the exact label 「地域ニュース・ライブ」 at the upper left. Below it, use a bold Meiryo-style Japanese sans-serif headline with these exact three lines and punctuation:

Keep the text left-aligned with the compact spacing and strong hierarchy shown in the native preview, scaled to a 1125x467 landscape canvas. Preserve clear green space below the headline. Do not include any English copy, extra text, photos, icons beyond the status dot, borders, gradients, or controls. Produce one flat component image.
